# View Details

## Stepwise Guide

1.  Log in to the software entering your username and password.
2.  In the left sidebar menu, go to 'Vendor > View List'.

    ![](https://learn.udyogx.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/update-vendor.png)

3.  In the list, find the vendor , and hover on the filter arrow located next to it.
4.  A dropdown menu would appear. Select 'Vendor > View Details'.

    ![](https://learn.udyogx.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/vendor-view-profile.png)
    
5.  The view details page will open.
